description: Supplies the "@"-mention suggestions of a composer. The composer calls SearchAsync with the text the reader typed after the "@", debounced by MentionDebounce and with a cancellation token that is cancelled as soon as the query changes, the list closes or the component is disposed — so a slow search never repaints a stale list and a host can pass the token straight to its API call. The interface lives in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions on purpose: a backend or an API client implements it without a Blazor reference. An exception is caught by the composer, which closes the list and announces a localized failure.

members.name: SearchAsync
members.type: Task<IReadOnlyList<AiMentionItem>> SearchAsync(string query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
members.description: Returns the mentions matching the text after the trigger (possibly empty, which asks for the default suggestions). An implementation must honour the cancellation token and should be cheap for short queries; an empty list closes the suggestion list.
